name: merged-ziplofy
description: Monorepo dev orchestration for server, Ziplofy, Ziplofy3b, render-store, and frontend

scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-backend-builds.mjs && concurrently -k -n server,ziplofy,ziplofy3b,render-store,frontend -c magenta,yellow,green,cyan,white "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix Ziplofy" "npm run dev:watch --prefix Ziplofy3b" "npm run dev --prefix render-store" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --port 5174"
scripts.dev:auth: node scripts/ensure-backend-builds.mjs && concurrently -k -n server,ziplofy -c magenta,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix Ziplofy"
scripts.dev:backends: node scripts/ensure-backend-builds.mjs && concurrently -k -n server,ziplofy3b -c magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:watch --prefix Ziplofy3b"
scripts.dev:frontends: concurrently -k -n ziplofy,render-store,frontend -c yellow,cyan,white "npm run dev --prefix Ziplofy" "npm run dev --prefix render-store" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --port 5174"
scripts.dev:server: node scripts/ensure-backend-builds.mjs && npm run dev --prefix server
scripts.dev:api: node scripts/ensure-backend-builds.mjs && npm run dev:watch --prefix Ziplofy3b
